assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optical lattice clocks transformed precision timekeeping while enabling unusually clean tests of fundamental physics.
assessment.attribution: Katori introduced the magic-wavelength lattice-clock concept, and Ye made decisive pioneering experimental contributions.
assessment.maturity: Independent clock realizations, extraordinary agreement, and broad scientific use make this exceptionally mature.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Trapped-ion quantum computation united a concrete quantum-information architecture with exquisite coherent control of atoms.
assessment.attribution: Cirac and Zoller supplied a seminal scheme, while Blatt led landmark experimental realization and development.
assessment.maturity: The central ideas have been repeatedly realized and have seeded a major experimental field.
uncertainties: Quantum-information architectures overlap substantially, making the boundary of a single prize difficult.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Geometric and electromagnetic quantum phases changed the conceptual description of interference and have had far-reaching consequences.
assessment.attribution: Berry and Aharonov are central names for distinct foundational phase effects represented by this broad nomination.
assessment.maturity: Both effects have been extensively tested and incorporated across atomic, optical, and condensed-matter physics.
uncertainties: The Aharonov-Bohm effect and Berry phase are distinct discoveries, so combining them raises attribution and prize-scope questions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Strongly interacting Fermi gases created a controllable laboratory for universal many-body quantum physics.
assessment.attribution: These groups made foundational and complementary experimental contributions to the crossover and its precision characterization.
assessment.maturity: The physics has been reproduced widely and now supports quantitative comparison between experiment and many-body theory.
uncertainties: Several other experimental and theoretical groups made essential contributions.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Atom interferometry made quantum phase coherence a powerful tool for inertial sensing and precision tests.
assessment.attribution: Bordé developed key conceptual foundations, while Pritchard and Kasevich made defining experimental advances.
assessment.maturity: The methods are robust, broadly reproduced, and continue to yield precision measurements.
uncertainties: The field has a long and distributed lineage, complicating a three-person attribution.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Rydberg blockade turned neutral atoms into programmable, interacting quantum systems with remarkable microscopic control.
assessment.attribution: Saffman developed central blockade and gate concepts, while Browaeys and Lukin made pivotal experimental platforms.
assessment.maturity: Large arrays and coherent control are convincingly established across multiple laboratories.
uncertainties: The rapid expansion of neutral-atom platforms leaves the eventual canonical attribution unsettled.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Cavity optomechanics enabled quantum control and measurement of mechanical motion, extending quantum optics to massive objects.
assessment.attribution: These researchers made leading complementary contributions to theory-guided experiments and device platforms.
assessment.maturity: Ground-state cooling, quantum-limited measurement, and coherent control are established achievements.
uncertainties: Credit is distributed among several early theoretical and experimental approaches.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: High-gain X-ray free-electron lasers opened an unprecedented ultrafast and atomically resolved window on matter.
assessment.attribution: Kim provided crucial theory, while Pellegrini and Rossbach were central to turning the concept into working facilities.
assessment.maturity: The principle is decisively demonstrated and has become an indispensable experimental capability.
uncertainties: The achievement depends on broad accelerator and facility collaborations beyond the named individuals.
